name: Sportsmanship
overview: Scripture teaches that true sportsmanship reflects humility, kindness, and a spirit of edification rather than self-glory or pride. Believers are encouraged to esteem others above themselves and avoid rejoicing in the misfortune of opponents, instead seeking to build up and please one another for their good. The fruit of the Spirit—love, gentleness, and patience—should characterize our conduct, demonstrating Christlike character in competition and relationships.
